text_block_list.text:
One day, while Смарт Фалкон and I are
out
together...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, look at that! ☆ What adorable

plushies! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
She's looking at a claw machine filled
with little
Umamusume plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I bet surrounding myself with these
adorable
things will up my Umadol
power! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
In that case, I've got a request for
you. ☆ I'd just
love it if you could get
me some plushies! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be cheering you on with
all my
spirit!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I believe in you, Trainer! You got this! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It seems like I'm getting roped into this.
All the
same...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
